message.content:
Electric skillets for domestic use fall under heading 8516, "Electrothermic appliances of a kind used for domestic purposes." Subheading 8516.60 covers other ovens, cookers, cooking plates, boiling rings, grillers and roasters. The statistical suffixes are 8516.60.40 (cooking stoves, ranges and ovens), 8516.60.60 (other cooking appliances), and 8516.60.80 (other). Customs rulings on electric skillets and griddles generally place them under 8516.60.4000, which is described as "Other ovens; cookers, cooking plates, boiling rings, grillers and roasters: Cooking stoves, ranges, and ovens: Other." The remaining candidates are 8516.60.6000 (Other: Other) and 8516.79.00 (Other electrothermic appliances), where 8516.79 includes items like electric skillets.

Reviewing the actual 8516.60 structure:
- 8516.60.20: Cooking stoves, ranges, ovens (household-type)
- 8516.60.40: Other: Cooking stoves, ranges and ovens... 
- 8516.60.60: Other
- 8516.60.80: Other

In practice, CBP rulings on electric skillets cite 8516.60.6000. Electric skillets, woks and griddles are also commonly classified there. The best answer is therefore 8516.60.6000, though I am relying on recalled rulings and have not checked the current schedule.
